point_effects.choice_prompt: Nine-Needle Cascade after {actor}'s {action} touches {first}: choose one additional creature. It makes a Dexterity save; on failure, choose a Numbing Point penalty until the start of your next turn. No additional cost. You may decline.
point_effects.evidence: Choose one additional creature within 10 feet of the target

on_fail.evidence: Failed Save: Apply Numbing Point to the second creature.

effects.evidence: Failed Save: Apply Numbing Point to the second creature.

tianxia.talent.pressure_points.nine_need.why: Nine-Needle Cascade is a Point the character picks, so its second creature clause only runs if the talent is registered as an owned Point (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py reads this block). The extra creature is picked within 10 feet of the creature already touched and makes its own save.
